description:
Every pre-event briefing we run takes 45 minutes. Clients sometimes ask why it cannot be 15.

Because 15 minutes produces a generic shot list. 45 minutes surfaces the information that does not appear in any written brief.

The VIP guests the internal coordinator forgot to mention. The mandatory stage shot that only exists because of a sponsor agreement. The timing window that closes 10 minutes into the program because the CEO leaves early.

None of that comes from a form. It comes from a structured conversation.

Every briefing we have shortened has required a revision call afterward. The 45 minutes at the start eliminates three hours at the end.

How much time do you typically spend briefing a photographer before an event?
